grammarNote.rule: Present Perfect (have/has + V3) vs Past Simple (V2 / did + V1)
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: Use Present Perfect for life experience or a past action with a result right now. Use Past Simple when you name a finished time (yesterday, two days ago). O‘zbek tilida ikkalasi ham ko‘pincha '-gan/-di' bilan beriladi, ammo inglizchada aniq o‘tgan vaqt kelsa faqat Past Simple ishlatiladi.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: Используйте Present Perfect для опыта или результата в настоящем, а Past Simple, когда назван завершённый момент (yesterday, two days ago). В русском оба времени переводятся прошедшим, но маркеры законченного времени запрещают Present Perfect.
grammarNote.structure: Subject + have/has (+ already/never) + V3 | Subject + haven't/hasn't + V3 ... yet | Subject + V2 + [finished time]
positiveExamples: I have already checked in online for the Prague flight.
I booked my student accommodation two days ago.
negativeExamples: The confirmation email hasn't arrived yet.

questions: Have you ever missed a connecting flight?

commonMistakes: Combining a finished time marker with Present Perfect ('I have booked it two days ago' is wrong; say 'I booked it two days ago'), or using 'yet' in positive statements instead of 'already'.

steps.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple in Travel
steps.titleRu: Present Perfect и Past Simple в поездках
steps.content: Choose Present Perfect (have/has + V3) when the exact past time does not matter and the result affects right now. Use 'already' in positive updates and 'yet' at the end of questions or negatives. Switch to Past Simple the moment you mention a finished time such as 'yesterday' or 'two days ago'. O‘zbek tilida ikkala zamon ham '-gan/-di' bilan tarjima qilinishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada aniq vaqt ko‘rsatkichi kelsa Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
steps.contentRu: Выбирайте Present Perfect (have/has + V3), когда важно состояние и результат сейчас, а не точная дата в прошлом. Используйте 'already' в утверждениях и 'yet' в вопросах и отрицаниях. Как только вы называете завершённое время ('yesterday', 'two days ago'), переходите на Past Simple, хотя в русском оба варианта звучат как прошедшее время.

grammarNote.rule: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + V1) & Cause/Result (because / since / so)
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: Use First Conditional for real future possibilities: the 'if'-clause takes Present Simple, and the main clause takes 'will'. O‘zbek tilida ikkala qismda ham kelasi zamon ('agar ishlamasa, yuboramiz') ko‘rinadi, lekin inglizchada 'if' dan keyin hech qachon 'will' qo‘yilmaydi. Shuningdek, bitta gapda ham 'because', ham 'so' ni birga ishlatmang.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: В First Conditional после 'if' всегда ставится Present Simple (никогда 'will'!), а в главной части — 'will + V1'. В русском в обеих частях звучит будущее («если не сработает, отправим»), поэтому легко допустить ошибку. И не объединяйте 'because' и 'so' в одном предложении.
grammarNote.structure: If + Subject + Present Simple, Subject + will + V1 | Because/Since + [cause], [result] | [cause], so + [result]
positiveExamples: If the portal stays offline, we will email the PDF directly.
Since the server crashed, we exported a local backup.
negativeExamples: If the portal does not come back online by three, we will postpone the demo.
We didn't lose the file because Timur saved a copy.
questions: What will we do if the printer stops working before noon?
Why couldn't Timur upload the report on time?
commonMistakes: Putting 'will/won't' inside the 'if'-clause ('If it won't work...' -> wrong; say 'If it doesn't work...'), and writing double connectors ('Because it rained, so we stayed' -> remove 'so').

pronunciationFocus.uz: Notice the quick contraction 'we'll' /wiːl/ vs full 'will' /wɪl/, and second-syllable stress in 'postpone' /pəˈspəʊn/.
pronunciationFocus.ru: Обратите внимание на краткую форму 'we'll' /wiːl/ и ударение на второй слог в 'postpone' /pəˈspəʊn/.

steps.title: First Conditional & Cause-Result Connectors
steps.titleRu: First Conditional и связки причины и следствия
steps.content: When a real problem threatens a deadline, First Conditional connects the condition ('If + Present Simple') to the action plan ('will + V1'). Never place 'will' inside the 'if'-clause, even though both Uzbek and Russian translate the condition with future meaning. Use 'because' or 'since' before a reason, or 'so' before a result, never both together. Inglizchada bitta gapda 'because' va 'so' yonma-yon kelmaydi.
steps.contentRu: Для реальных условий будущего используйте First Conditional: после 'if' ставится Present Simple (без 'will'), а в основной части — 'will + V1'. Слова 'because' и 'since' вводят причину, а 'so' — результат; в одном английском предложении их не совмещают.
highlightNotes: Condition (Present Simple): If the portal doesn't work by 3:00,
Result (will + V1): we will email the PDF directly.
Single connector: Because the server crashed, we exported a backup.

options: Because the power went out, we postponed the meeting.

Since the power went out, so we postponed the meeting.
So the power went out, because we postponed the meeting.

Because the power went out, therefore we.uz: «Because» ishlatilganda asosiy gap boshida «therefore» qo‘shish ham ortiqcha ikkilangan bog‘lovchi bo‘ladi.
Because the power went out, therefore we.ru: При наличии «Because» добавлять «therefore» перед главной частью также избыточно.

Since the power went out, so we postpone.uz: «Since» sababni bildiradi, shuning uchun «so» natija bog‘lovchisi bilan bir gapda kelmaydi.

grammarNote.rule: Unless (= if not) + Positive Present Simple, will + V1
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: 'Unless' means 'if you do not'. Never add 'not' inside an 'unless'-clause: say 'Unless you save a backup', NOT 'Unless you don't save'.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: Союз 'unless' уже несёт отрицание («если не»), поэтому после него используется утвердительный Present Simple.
grammarNote.structure: Unless + Subject + Present Simple, Subject + will + V1
positiveExamples: Unless you download the pack beforehand, you will need mobile data.
negativeExamples: Do not use 'won't' or 'don't' directly after 'unless' for this warning.

commonMistakes: Using double negation ('Unless you don't save...') or placing 'will' after 'unless'.

steps.title: Checkpoint Briefing: 'Unless' & Deadline Logic
steps.content: In official notices, 'unless' replaces 'if ... not' with a positive verb. Qo‘shimcha soatlarni dastlabki muddatga qo‘shib hisoblang.
steps.contentRu: В деловых объявлениях союз 'unless' заменяет 'if ... not' и требует утвердительного глагола. Всегда прибавляйте время продления к исходному дедлайну.

warmUp.uz: Picture a hackathon workshop: your team is running a test, and suddenly the lights go out. How do English speakers show which action was longer?

grammarNote.rule: Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) + Past Simple (V2) & Relative Clauses (who / which / where)
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: Use Past Continuous ('was testing') for the ongoing background and Past Simple ('cut') for the sudden interruption. Use 'who' for people, 'which' for things, and 'where' for places (meaning 'in that place'). O‘zbek va rus tillaridan farqli o‘laroq, nisbiy gapda ortiqcha olmosh ('who she helped' emas, faqat 'who helped') qo‘shilmaydi.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: Используйте Past Continuous ('was testing') для длительного фона и Past Simple ('cut') для внезапного события. Для людей берите 'who', для предметов — 'which', для места действия («где») — 'where'. Не дублируйте подлежащее лишним местоимением ('who she helped' — ошибка).
grammarNote.structure: While + Subject + was/were + V-ing, Subject + V2 | Noun + who/which/where + clause
positiveExamples: While our team was testing the prototype, a storm cut the electricity.
A student who sat beside us lent us a battery which kept the laptop running.
negativeExamples: We weren't expecting a storm while we were working in the lab.
questions: What was your team doing when the power went out?
Where is the workshop where you built the prototype?
commonMistakes: Adding a duplicate pronoun after 'who/which' ('the colleague who he lent us' -> 'the colleague who lent us'), or confusing 'where' (action inside a place) with 'which' (describing the place as an object).

pronunciationFocus.uz: Use weak forms /wəz/ for 'was' and /wə/ for 'were' in background clauses. 'Colleague' /ˈkɒliːɡ/ has two syllables, not three.
pronunciationFocus.ru: В потоке речи 'was' /wəz/ и 'were' /wə/ звучат безударно. Слово 'colleague' /ˈkɒliːɡ/ состоит из двух слогов.

steps.title: Background Action, Interruption & Relative Clauses
steps.content: Start a story by setting the ongoing scene with Past Continuous ('was/were + V-ing'), then introduce the sudden event in Past Simple. Connect extra detail smoothly with 'who' (people), 'which' (things), and 'where' (places where an action happens). Never repeat a subject pronoun right after 'who' or 'which'. O‘zbek tilida «yordam bergan hamkasb» iborasida ortiqcha olmosh bo‘lmaganidek, inglizchada ham «who he helped» deb yozilmaydi.
steps.contentRu: Начинайте рассказ с длительного фона в Past Continuous ('was/were + V-ing'), а внезапное событие подавайте в Past Simple. Уточняйте детали через 'who' (люди), 'which' (предметы) и 'where' (место действия), но не ставьте лишнее местоимение после 'who/which'.

grammarNote.rule: When + Past Simple vs While + Past Continuous | Zero Duplicate Pronoun in Relative Clauses
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: Use 'while' before an ongoing action ('while she was scanning') and 'when' before a short event. Never place 'he/she/it' right after 'who/which' when it is the subject.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: 'while' ставится перед длительным действием, а 'when' — перед коротким событием. После 'who/which' в роли подлежащего не добавляется 'he/she/it'.
grammarNote.structure: While + was/were -ing | Person + who + Verb (no extra he/she)

I met an engineer yesterday which design.uz: «which» narsa-buyumlar uchun ishlatiladi; muhandis (shaxs) uchun «who» kerak.
I met an engineer yesterday which design.ru: «which» используется для предметов, а для человека (инженера) требуется «who».

warmUp.uz: Suppose 30% of app testers cannot sign in, while teammates ask for dark mode. Which task is a 'must', and how do you tell developers what the mentor said?

grammarNote.rule: Advice & Obligation (should / ought to / must) & Reported Statements (said / told + backshift)
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: 'should' and 'ought to' give advice, whereas 'must' expresses strict urgency. Never add 'to' after 'should' or 'must', but always keep 'to' in 'ought to'. In reported speech after 'said/told', shift 'can -> could', 'will -> would', 'am/is -> was'. 'said' dan keyin bevosita shaxs olmoshi kelmaydi ('told us that', 'said that').
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: 'should' и 'ought to' выражают совет, а 'must' — строгую необходимость. После 'should/must' частица 'to' не ставится, а 'ought to' всегда требует 'to'. В косвенной речи после 'said/told' сдвигаем 'can -> could', 'will -> would'. После 'said' не ставится прямое дополнение ('told us', но 'said that').
grammarNote.structure: Subject + should/must + V1 | Subject + ought to + V1 | Subject + told + [person] + (that) + [backshifted clause]
positiveExamples: You must fix the timeout bug before Friday, and you ought to notify the testers.
The mentor told us that sign-in access was our top priority.
negativeExamples: We should not postpone critical bug fixes.
questions: Should we add dark mode before fixing the sign-in timeout?
commonMistakes: Writing 'should to test' or 'said me that' instead of 'should test' and 'told me that'.

pronunciationFocus.uz: The letter 'l' is silent in 'should' /ʃʊd/. In natural speech, 'ought to' blends smoothly into /ˈɔːtə/.
pronunciationFocus.ru: Буква 'l' в 'should' /ʃʊd/ не читается. В беглой речи 'ought to' сливается в /ˈɔːtə/.

steps.title: Advice Modals & Basic Reported Statements
steps.titleRu: Модальные глаголы совета и косвенная речь
steps.content: Choose 'should' or 'ought to' for balanced recommendations, and reserve 'must' for urgent rules or critical priorities. Notice that 'should' and 'must' connect directly to the base verb without 'to', while 'ought to' keeps 'to'. When reporting what someone decided earlier ('said / told us'), shift 'will -> would', 'can -> could', and 'am/is -> was', and remember 'tell' needs a listener ('told us') while 'say' does not. O‘zbek tilida «menga aytdi» iborasiga moslab «said me» deyish ko‘p uchraydigan xato — to‘g‘risi «told me».
steps.contentRu: Используйте 'should' или 'ought to' для рекомендаций и 'must' для срочных правил. После 'should/must' частица 'to' не нужна, а в 'ought to' она обязательна. Передавая слова в прошлом ('said / told us'), сдвигайте 'will -> would', 'can -> could', 'am/is -> was' и помните: 'told us', но 'said that' (без 'me/us').
highlightNotes: Advice vs urgency: We ought to test on Saturday, and we must fix the bug first.
Listener rule: She told us that... / She said that... (NEVER said us)
Backshift: 'I can send it' -> She said that she could send it.

dialogueContext: Aziz: "Should we add dark mode before fixing the sign-in timeout?"
interactiveQuestion.text: Audiodagi muhokamaga ko‘ra, mentorning ustuvor qarorini aks ettiruvchi javobni tanlang:
interactiveQuestion.textRu: Выберите ответ ментора, отражающий принятый приоритет в диалоге:
options: No, sign-in access is our top priority, so you must fix the timeout bug before Friday.
Yes, add dark mode first and postpone the sign-in bug until next month.
You do not need to test again on Saturday or notify the mobile testers.
Ignore the verification code problem because thirty percent is a small number.

You do not need to test again on Saturda.ru: Ментор посоветовал уведомить тестировщиков, а Азиз предложил повторный тест в субботу утром.

Ignore the verification code problem bec.uz: 30% foydalanuvchi tizimga kira olmagani uchun mentor buni eng muhim muammo deb baholadi.
Ignore the verification code problem bec.ru: Из-за сбоя у 30% тестировщиков ментор назвал это главной проблемой.

steps.content: Write a 4-sentence message reporting what a teammate suggested and recommending two clear next steps.

interactiveQuestion.topic: Writing: Reporting decisions and recommending next actions
interactiveQuestion.text: Jamoaga 4 gapli ish xabari yozing: hamkasbingiz nima deganini o‘zlashtirma gapda (told/said) yetkazing va 'should' / 'ought to' hamda 'priority' so‘zi bilan ikki keyingi qadamni tavsiya qiling.
interactiveQuestion.textRu: Напишите командное сообщение из 4 предложений: передайте слова коллеги через told/said и порекомендуйте два шага со словами 'should' / 'ought to' и 'priority'.
interactiveQuestion.sampleResponse: Aziz told us that thirty percent of testers could not complete sign-in. Fixing that bug is our top priority before Friday. We ought to postpone new design changes until next week. We should also run a follow-up check on Saturday morning.

interactiveQuestion.wrongFeedbackRu: Проверьте наличие косвенной речи, двух модальных рекомендаций и лексики приоритетов.

reinforcementExercise.topic: Basic reported statement with can -> could
reinforcementExercise.text: Alining «Men bugun kun tartibini yubora olaman» («I can send the agenda today») degan gapini o‘zlashtirma gapga aylantirib, «Ali told us ...» bilan boshlab ingliz tilida to‘liq yozing.
reinforcementExercise.textRu: Преобразуйте слова Али «Я могу отправить повестку дня сегодня» («I can send the agenda today») в косвенную речь на английском, начав с «Ali told us ...».
acceptedAnswers: Ali told us that he could send the agenda that day
Ali told us that he could send the agenda today
Ali told us he could send the agenda that day
Ali told us he could send the agenda today
reinforcementExercise.explanation: In reported statements, 'I' changes to 'he' and 'can' shifts back to 'could': 'Ali told us that he could send the agenda that day.'
reinforcementExercise.explanationRu: В косвенной речи 'I' заменяется на 'he', а модальный глагол сдвигается на шаг назад ('could').

grammarNote.rule: Integrated B1 Synthesis: Tense Contrast + First Conditional + Reported Action
grammarNote.simpleExplanationUz: Check time markers before picking Present Perfect or Past Simple, keep 'if'-clauses in Present Simple, and remember 'told + person' + backshifted modal.
grammarNote.simpleExplanationRu: Сверяйте маркеры времени перед выбором Present Perfect/Past Simple, оставляйте Present Simple после 'if' и сдвигайте глаголы после 'told + лицо'.
grammarNote.structure: have/has + V3 | If + Present Simple, will/should + V1 | told + person + that + could/would
positiveExamples: The organizer said that if we don't find a cable, we should share the slide link.
negativeExamples: Never say 'She said me that the train will arrive late'.
questions: Has the technician checked the storage room yet?
commonMistakes: Mixing 'said me' with missing modal backshift ('will' instead of 'would').

pronunciationFocus.ru: Выделяйте вводные слова 'Actually,' и 'Glad you made it!' чёткой интонацией.

interactiveQuestion.text: Audiodagi suhbatga ko‘ra, konferensiyada qanday nosozlik yuz berdi va 10:15 gacha zaxira kabel topilmasa nima qilinadi?
interactiveQuestion.textRu: Какая поломка произошла на конференции и что сделают, если запасной кабель не найдётся до 10:15?
options: Proyektor kabeli uzildi; slayd havolasini ulashib, savol-javobni 15 daqiqa ertaroq boshlashadi
Malikaning poyezdi kechikdi; tadbir keyingi oyga ko‘chiriladi
Spikerning noutbuki buzildi; texnik xodim do‘kondan yangi kompyuter olib keladi
Omborxona qulflanib qoldi; savol-javob qismi butunlay bekor qilinadi

Malikaning poyezdi kechikdi; tadbir keyi.uz: Malika o‘tgan oydan farqli o‘laroq bugun poyezdi o‘z vaqtida yetib kelganini aytdi.
Malikaning poyezdi kechikdi; tadbir keyi.ru: Малика сказала, что сегодня поезд прибыл вовремя (задержка была в прошлом месяце).

Spikerning noutbuki buzildi; texnik xodi.uz: Noutbuk emas, asosiy proyektor kabeli uzilgan va texnik omborxonadan zaxira kabel qidirmoqda.
Spikerning noutbuki buzildi; texnik xodi.ru: Сломался не ноутбук, а кабель проектора; техник ищет запасной в кладовой.

Omborxona qulflanib qoldi; savol-javob q.uz: Savol-javob bekor qilinmaydi, aksincha 15 daqiqa ertaroq boshlanishi aytildi.
Omborxona qulflanib qoldi; savol-javob q.ru: Сессию вопросов и ответов не отменяют, а переносят на 15 минут раньше.

steps.title: 3. Reading: Community Scholarship Guidelines
steps.content: Read the scholarship update carefully and select the accurate next step for applicants.

interactiveQuestion.contextSnippet: Regional Youth Scholarship Update: Applicants who have already uploaded their essay do not need to resubmit it. However, if your mentor recommendation letter has not arrived by Friday at 18:00, you ought to contact the admissions desk before Monday morning.
interactiveQuestion.text: E’longa ko‘ra, inshosini yuklagan, ammo tavsiya xati juma soat 18:00 gacha yetib kelmagan nomzod nima qilishi kerak?
interactiveQuestion.textRu: Что должен сделать кандидат, который уже загрузил эссе, но рекомендательное письмо не пришло к 18:00 пятницы?
options: Inshoni qayta yuklamaydi, lekin dushanba tongidan oldin qabul bo‘limi bilan bog‘lanishi kerak
Inshoni juma kuni qayta topshirishi va dushanba kuni kelishini kutishi kerak
Hujjatlari bekor qilingani uchun keyingi yilgacha kutishi kerak
Tavsiya xatini o‘zi yozib dushanba kuni kechqurun yuborishi kerak

Inshoni juma kuni qayta topshirishi va d.uz: Matnda allaqachon yuklangan inshoni qayta topshirish shart emasligi («do not need to resubmit») yozilgan.
Inshoni juma kuni qayta topshirishi va d.ru: В тексте указано, что уже загруженное эссе повторно отправлять не нужно («do not need to resubmit»).

Hujjatlari bekor qilingani uchun keyingi.uz: Ariza bekor qilinmagan; nomzod dushanba tongidan oldin qabul bo‘limiga murojaat qilishi tavsiya etilgan.
Hujjatlari bekor qilingani uchun keyingi.ru: Заявка не аннулирована — рекомендовано связаться с приёмной комиссией до утра понедельника.

Tavsiya xatini o‘zi yozib dushanba kuni.uz: Matnda xatni o‘zi yozish haqida gap yo‘q, balki dushanba tongidan oldin bog‘lanish aytilgan.
Tavsiya xatini o‘zi yozib dushanba kuni.ru: Нужно связаться с отделом до утра понедельника, а не писать рекомендацию самостоятельно.

steps.title: 5. Sentence Construction: Reported Advice
steps.content: Order the chunks to report the mentor's recommendation accurately.
steps.contentRu: Расставьте фрагменты в верном порядке, чтобы передать совет ментора.

interactiveQuestion.topic: B1 Exit: Reported advice sentence order
interactiveQuestion.text: «Mentor bugun zaxira rejamizni sinab ko‘rishimiz kerakligini aytdi» gapini to‘g‘ri tartibda tuzing:
interactiveQuestion.textRu: Составьте предложение «Ментор сказал, что нам следует проверить запасной план сегодня» в правильном порядке:
acceptedAnswers: The mentor said that we ought to test our backup plan today.
interactiveQuestion.explanation: Order: reporting clause ('The mentor said that') + subject + modal ('we ought') + infinitive ('to test') + object + time ('our backup plan today.').
interactiveQuestion.explanationRu: Порядок: вводная часть, затем подлежащее с модальной конструкцией и инфинитивом, дополнение и время в конце.

reinforcementExercise.topic: B1 Exit: Reported speech listener and backshift
reinforcementExercise.sentenceWithError: She said me that the train will arrive late.
reinforcementExercise.text: O‘zlashtirma gapdagi tinglovchi fe’li va zamon surilishi xatosini tuzating:
reinforcementExercise.textRu: Исправьте две ошибки косвенной речи (глагол и сдвиг времени):
options: She told me that the train would arrive late.
She said me that the train would arrive late.
She told to me that the train will arrive late.
She told me that the train will arriving late.

She said me that the train would arrive.uz: «said» dan keyin bevosita «me» qo‘yilmaydi; shaxs ko‘rsatilganda «told me» ishlatiladi.
She said me that the train would arrive.ru: После «said» нельзя сразу ставить «me» — при указании адресата нужен глагол «told me».

She told to me that the train will arriv.uz: «told» dan keyin «to» kelmaydi va «will» o‘tgan zamondan keyin «would» ga o‘tishi kerak.
She told to me that the train will arriv.ru: После «told» предлог «to» не нужен, а «will» должно сдвинуться в «would».

She told me that the train will arriving.uz: «will» ham zamon jihatdan orqaga surilmagan, ham «will» dan keyin «-ing» kelmaydi.
She told me that the train will arriving.ru: Глагол «will» не сдвинут в прошедшую форму, и после него нельзя ставить «-ing».

reinforcementExercise.explanation: Use 'told me' (no 'to', never 'said me') and shift 'will' back to 'would' after a past reporting verb.
